description: The 2026-10-16 card walkthrough reported the Citi Sixt Rent A Car offer as an enrollment FAILURE ('Unable to enroll merchant offer. Please try again.', twice). David checked: the offer WAS added. The error message was misleading and the agent recorded the failure without re-verifying the enrolled list, which would have shown it.
correction: On an enrollment error, re-read the enrolled/added list before recording a failure. An error message is not proof of failure. Report the offer as added if the enrolled list shows it, and only record a genuine failure when the list confirms it is absent.
root_cause: Trusted the portal's error toast over the ground truth on the same page.
